text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess manages to produce
a great
result in the Victoria Mile.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I'm waiting in the runner's tunnel for
her to
return...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami looked like she had fun. I
noticed it
during the race, too.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.
choice_data_list: 彼女らしい走りだっただろ？
彼女らしい走りだったでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's to be expected. She did get
a push in
the right direction from yours
truly!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, a push! What's there to doubt?
Have you
not been paying attention?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I totally called Kawakami out on her

shortcomings!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's my role as the more seasoned racer! I
made
my debut before her, you know?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Grrr! What's wrong with you?! You
should be
showing me much more
gratitude!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Start with a "thank you" at least! Then
you can
treat me to a delicious juice!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh my—Trainer! And Sweep's here, too.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. ♪ I'm actually on my way out!
Don't forget
you owe me thanks as well,
Kawakami!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
My... Sweep looked much more cheerful
than
usual!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it doesn't really surprise me,
though.
Today's race was...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Really fun, after all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the concert, we return to the
academy.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, would you stay with me for a
little
longer tonight?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: It's nothing. I just...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Come on! This way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess immediately dashes
off,
leaving me to chase after her into
the school
building.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Wooow! The stars are so pretty!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
We're so high up. It's scary to even think
about
what would happen if I fell.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I knooow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami has led me out onto the
school's roof. I
check the time—the
school building will be
closing soon.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. The first three years an
Umamusume
and her trainer spend
together are really
important, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The first three years... If an Umamusume
hasn't
achieved a satisfactory record by
the end of the
third year after making
her debut...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's a good chance it will lead to her
parting
ways with her trainer.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...There's no way that'll happen to us! I
mean,
we've already come so far
together!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. You just failed your Legendary
Trainer
test.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Don't just hope. You have to say this definitely won't be the end.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Don't just hope. You have to say this definitely won't be the end.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
In my junior year, you told me that if I
wanted to
become a princess, I needed
to focus on getting
used to racing
before entering G1 races.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
In my classic year, you continued to
guide me
along even when I was lost and
unsure of what to
do.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
You're the person who helped me learn
what it
truly means to be myself. You're
my ultimate
partner!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: That's why I...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I want to keep running along this path
together.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
If we ever have to say farewell, it
shouldn't be
until a long, long time from
now.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Of course! And I'll become your
Legendary
Princess!
choice_data_list: 俺は君の“伝説のトレーナー”になるよ
私は貴方の“伝説のトレーナー”になるよ

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now, if we want that to happen, we'd
better
produce some real jaw-dropping
results in these
last six months!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, the spring Grand Prix?! The
contest of
contests that brings the G1
spring season to a
close!
choice_data_list: 手始めに『宝塚記念』へ行こうか

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Roger that! I feel like the experience will
be an
essential step for me as I proceed
down my
princess road!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Now, let's run wild!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Kawakami Princess and I decide
to set
the Takarazuka Kinen as her next
objective.
